How to Apply
Why choose Western University?
Western University combines research excellence, expert faculty mentorship, and a vibrant graduate community. With diverse programs and opportunities for collaboration across disciplines, Western prepares graduate students to make meaningful contributions in their fields and beyond.
Driven by research and impact.
As one of Canada’s leading research universities, Western fosters innovation, curiosity, and cross-disciplinary collaboration, with graduate students at the center of discovery.
Mentored by leading scholars.
Through research, community scholarship, or professional practice, you’ll benefit from award-winning faculty mentorship and a vibrant graduate community.
A globally connected campus.
With a strong international student population and partnerships around the world, Western prepares graduate students to lead locally and globally — all from a beautiful campus in London, Ontario.
